title: 23 Dartmouth Square, Dublin 6, D06X090
description:
Number 23 Dartmouth Square is an exceptionally fine two-storey over garden level period residence, ideally positioned in this delightful terrace of imposing Victorian properties with enviable and direct views over and access to Dartmouth Square. Once home to former Lord Mayor of Dublin, Mr Alfie Byrne, this charming, light filled family home was tastefully extended and reconfigured by its current owners when they purchased in 2004. This fine property now offers the perfect fusion of contemporary design along with its original period features, creating wonderful, light filled rooms of elegant proportions. 

Extending to 276 sq.m./2,970 sq.ft., the gracious accommodation is laid out over three levels and comprises at hall floor level elegant interconnecting reception rooms with high corniced ceilings and a fantastic outlook over the square with a door leading to the original butler’s pantry, now cleverly used as drinks/cocktail area  and guest WC. The kitchen has been relocated to this level on the hall return allowing for seamless entertaining and living space.

The garden level is an outstanding feature of this home with a superb main bedroom with en suite shower room, cosy living room and a large garden room, currently used as a home office, with tri-folding doors opening out to the rear garden. There is also convenient under granite steps utility room and a door leading to the private south facing patio to the front of the house off the hallway.  The accommodation is completed by the three additional double bedrooms upstairs, a large reception room on the first floor return and a shower room at the top of the house.

The impressive interior is perfectly complemented by its beautifully planted, mature and manicured front and rear gardens providing interest throughout the year. To the front, the railed garden boasts decorative box hedging and attractive planting. A granite pathway leads to the front steps as well as the sunny, sunken patio area, a sun-drenched spot perfect for morning coffee.  To the rear, the granite walled rear garden is laid out mainly in lawn, framed by mature maple trees and by bamboo to the rear. It is bordered by well-stocked planters and a large, paved patio, the perfect sheltered spot for afternoon and evening dining. 

Located on the enviable north side one of Dublin’s most sought-after squares, adjacent to the Grand Canal, this property is perfectly placed for leisurely access to Leeson Street, Wilton Park, St Stephen’s Green, Grafton Street and the village atmosphere of Ranelagh. An exceptional array of amenities lies within easy reach, from artisan cafés and delicatessens to acclaimed restaurants and boutique shops. An outstanding selection of Dublin’s most prestigious primary and secondary schools is also close at hand.  The Green Line’s Charlemont stop is ideally positioned — a leisurely three-minute stroll that places the entire city at one’s fingertips, while the house itself remains a serene address.

Hall Level

Hall Original hall door with glazed panels on either side and overhead. A wide, welcoming hall with polished floorboards, decorative cornicing, picture rail, centre rose, dado rail and radiator cover.

Drawing Room Two sash windows overlooking the front garden and Dartmouth Square. Polished floorboards, orginal marble mantle piece with tiled hearth and surround, radiator covers, elaborate cornicing and centre rose. Double doors leading to the dining room.

Dining Room Matching orginal fireplace, polished wooden floors, radiator covers, cornice and centre rose. Sash window overlooking the rear garden.

Cloak storage/guest wc The original butler’s pantry is now used as a drinks/cocktail area and guest WC with wash hand basin and toilet.

HALL RETURN

Kitchen Range of painted solid pine units with larder press. 6 burner gas hob and extractor fan, Samsung American fridge freezer. Large island with breakfast bar and sink unit incorporated. Hotpoint dish washer. Tiled flooring, recessed lighting, radiator cover and glazed door leading to the hallway.

GARDEN LEVEL

Hall Entrance hall with tiled flooring and utility under granite steps. Double doors leading to inner hallway with tiled floors, recessed lighting, hot press and cloak storage. Feature open staircase leads to hall level.

Living Room Spacious reception room with herringbone wood flooring, open fireplace with natural stone surround & flanked by fitted shelving. Incorporates ceiling coving, centre rose and two sash windows overlooking the patio area and front garden. Double glazed door leading to Bedroom.

Bedroom 1 Large double room with fitted slide robes, herringbone wood floors and recessed lighting. Door opens out onto the rear garden.

En Suite Tiled flooring and walls, underfloor heating, recessed lighting, toilet, wash hand basin with under storage, mirror with back lighting. Walk-in shower cubicle with overhead rain showerhead. Door leading to rear garden.

Library Tiled flooring with fitted bookshelves and storage. Archway leading to the study.

Study/ Garden room Natural stone tiled floors, dual aspect with recessed lighting throughout. tri folding doors open out onto the rear garden.

First Return Polished timber floors and recessed lighting.

Reception Room/Bedroom 5 Currently in use as a sitting room. Includes two windows plus Velux window, pitched ceiling and recessed lighting.

First Floor Landing with Velux window, attic access, radiator cover and dado rail.

Bedroom 2 Large Double to the rear, sash window, polished timber floors, painted orginal mantlepiece with tiled surround and hearth, coving, recessed lighting and radiator covers.

Bedroom 3 Double room with wooden floors, original cast iron fireplace and sash window overlooking front garden and the square.

Bedroom 4 Generous single room with wooden floors, ceiling coving and original cast iron fireplace with tiled inset.

Top Return Large walk-in shower cubicle, toilet, wash hand basin with mixer tap, tiled flooring and partially tiled walls, large velux window.
features: Solar panels and two x 5 KW battery storage
External electric and water points front and rear.
